[EN] Thulsa's personal guards in the Ebon Tower are the Blood Legion, given immortality through Thulsa's necromancy.

Their life force is constantly renewed by artifacts called eternal hearts.

Destroy the Blood Legion and bring me their hearts. Without them, Thulsa can't bring them back.
[ES] La guardia personal de Thulsa en el Ebon Tower es la Blood Legion, a la que se le otorgó la inmortalidad mediante la nigromancia de Thulsa.

Su fuerza vital se renueva constantemente mediante artefactos llamados eternal hearts.

Destruye a la Blood Legion y tráeme sus corazones. Sin ellos, Thulsa no podrá revivirlos.

[EN] Well done, . We'll either find a way to destroy them, or the spirits of the Blood Legion can spend their eternal lives imprisoned.
[ES] Bien hecho, . O encontraremos la manera de destruirlos, o los espíritus de la Blood Legion pasarán sus vidas eternas prisioneros.

[EN] Make sure you bring back the eternal heart of every Blood Legion soldier you kill. Otherwise, Thulsa can give them new bodies.
[ES] Asegúrate de traer el eternal heart de cada soldado de la Blood Legion que mates. De lo contrario, Thulsa podrá darles cuerpos nuevos.
